notes: Probabilities are ensemble frequencies over group-bootstrap members, not calibrated frequentist coverage.
Candidates drawn from the same public measurement set the ensemble was fitted on make this an in-sample robustness analysis; read bootstrap_inclusion_frequency per candidate.
Model robustness does not replace literature evidence or experimental fact.
